delivery methods content:
- Products are delivered through the company’s dedicated delivery service.
- Delivery time: 3–7 days.
- Delivery fees:
• West Bank: ₪20 
• Jerusalem: ₪30 
• Inside the Green Line: ₪70
exchange policy content:
1- Please make sure to keep the invoice attached to the received package, as it is important for completing the exchange process correctly and includes key information such as the order number and product code.
2- Exchange requests must be submitted within 24 hours of receiving the package, giving customers enough time to check the product.
3- To request an exchange, contact us via WhatsApp messages shown at the bottom of the website or app and provide your phone number and order number as shown on the invoice.
4- Exchange fees are the same as delivery fees.
5- Exchange is free if a defect is found in the product that was not visible upon delivery. We advise checking the product with the delivery staff (e.g., size check) to avoid later exchanges.
6- You may exchange the product for another of equal price (excluding delivery fees) or for a higher-priced one by paying the price difference and exchange fees.
7- Exchange requests will not be accepted if the customer damages the product box or packaging or if the product is used. The product must be complete and unused.
return policy content:
- Return requests must be submitted within 24 hours of receiving the package.
- Return requests should be made via WhatsApp messages shown at the bottom of the website.
- Return requests will not be accepted if the customer damages the product box or packaging.
- The returned product must be complete, unused, and undamaged.
- Return fees (if no product defect is found): ₪20 for the West Bank and Jerusalem, ₪50 for areas within 1948.
- Return requests are processed within 5–7 business days.
- The delivery staff has the right to inspect the returned product before accepting it.
- The delivery staff may refuse to accept a return if the product was damaged due to misuse.
- The company reserves the right to reject returns that violate this policy.
- For Visa/MasterCard payments, refunds will be issued to the same card within 5 business days.
payment methods content:
- Available payment methods: cash on delivery or Visa/MasterCard.
- Customers have the right to inspect the product before paying.
- The payment method appears on the checkout page.
- Payments are made in Israeli Shekels (₪) as shown on the checkout page.
privacy policy content:
- We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
- Information is collected only to provide and improve our services.
- We do not share your data with third parties without your consent, except where required by law.
- We use advanced security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access or misuse.
- By using our website, you agree to this privacy policy.
- This policy may be updated from time to time, and users will be notified of any major changes.
